edits.reason: The two occurrences have different referents. The first describes the perverse person; the second describes God responding to that person. Rendering both as perverse wrongly suggests the same moral fault. NIV uses shrewd for the response; LBLA and NVI use sagaz, while RVR1960 uses severo. The parallel 2 Samuel 22:27 confirms the distinction. Only the second occurrence changes; the first perverse and the KJV pronouns remain.
